title: In the Eye of the Beholder: Human Label Variation in Textual and Visual Entailment
abstract: arXiv:2611.17954v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Human Label Variation (HLV) is increasingly recognised as an informative signal that reflects meaningful differences in how people interpret the same input. While HLV has been studied extensively in Natural Language Inference (NLI), much less is known about HLV in Visual Entailment (VE; Xie et al., 2019), where the textual premise is replaced by an image, keeping the hypothesis and label space fixed. We introduce VariNLI-VE, a dataset for studying how HLV changes between paired NLI and VE instances. We re-annotate a subset of originally neutral SNLI (Bowman et al., 2015) instances and their visual counterparts, with the same annotators evaluating both the textual and visual versions. Each annotation includes a label, confidence score, and explanation, yielding 2,250 annotations. Labels and explanations are collected jointly, providing ecologically valid explanations. translated_title: 旁观者眼中：文本与视觉蕴含中的人类标注差异
translated_abstract: 人类标注差异正日益被认识到是一种有信息量的信号，它反映了人们在对同一输入进行解读时存在的有意义差异。虽然人类标注差异在自然语言推理（NLI）领域已被广泛研究，但对于视觉蕴含（VE；Xie et al., 2019）中的人类标注差异却知之甚少——在视觉蕴含中，文本前提被图像所取代，而假设和标签空间保持不变。我们引入了VariNLI-VE，这是一个用于研究人类标注差异如何在成对的NLI与VE实例之间变化的数据集。我们对原本被标注为中性的SNLI（Bowman et al., 2015）实例的一个子集及其视觉对应版本进行了重新标注，由相同的标注者对文本版本和视觉版本进行评估。每个标注包含一个标签、一个置信度分数以及一段解释，共产生2,250个标注。标签和解释是联合收集的，从而提供了具有生态效度的解释。由于图像可能揭示文本中未陈述的信息，一个……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了VariNLI-VE数据集，通过让同一批标注者对成对的NLI文本实例及其视觉对应版本重新标注（包含标签、置信度和解释，共2,250条标注），系统研究人类标注差异如何在文本与视觉两种蕴含任务之间变化。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces VariNLI-VE, a dataset where the same annotators re-label paired NLI text instances and their visual counterparts with labels, confidence scores, and explanations (2,250 annotations in total), to systematically study how Human Label Variation differs between textual and visual entailment.
